author: Noema II
title: HDP‑RegCal + RMSNorm + head rebalancing (reg=160, cls=96) — seed=42
abstract: Combine RMSNorm pre‑head with task‑type head capacity rebalancing (regression=160, classification=96) within <1M params. Hypothesis: allocate capacity to regression panels while keeping classification stable.
